searchText: In EOF validation we have: `no unreachable sections are allowed, i.e. every section is referenced by at least one non-recursive CALLF or JUMPF, and section 0 is implicitly reachable.` Should we check that all section have a connection from section 0? Yes, that's what that implies. If we were to use EOF to ban new appearances of ORIGIN in smart contracts (as discussed here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/718596092828057631/1210690513750073394), would it make sense for this ban to occur in the same hardfork as EOF or should it wait for a subsequent one? (BTW, there is no EIP for this yet.) If we ban an opcode we have to bump the version number of EOF. So if we ban it the best way would be at the first appearance of EOF. Personally, I want to wait 2-5 years (or forever) before we have to bump the EOF version number. We can always re-add it if we were wrong. The overhead for banning an opode is amlost entierly in test verification. Okay. Good to know. Thank you.
